features.name: Batched client inbound synchronization
features.description: Route every client inbound attach/detach through one helper that groups clients by identical inbound sets, and make the five-minute Catalog V2 sync save per user and respect traffic depletion.
done_criteria: A single helper sends one bulkAttach or bulkDetach request per distinct sorted inbound set, and every client inbound synchronization path uses it.
A client whose attach request failed is never detached in the same round.
The five-minute Catalog V2 sync defers inbound changes until the loop ends and reports failed users individually.
The five-minute Catalog V2 sync persists changed users with per-record saves instead of rewriting the users collection.
The five-minute Catalog V2 sync keeps traffic-depleted clients disabled and re-enables them once traffic is available.
The five-minute Catalog V2 sync relies on the in-memory cache TTL; syncCatalogV2ToXui({ forceReload: true }) re-reads only the users and accounts collections.

features.name: Database inbound table with decoupled TCP probe
features.description: Persist the 3x-ui inbound list in an app table refreshed by the five-minute panel sync, probe only from that table, and stop inbound-list consumers from triggering TCP probes.
done_criteria: A xui_inbounds table stores each inbound's key, id, node, host, port, protocol, name, tag, enabled state, client count and recent activity, and is replaced from the five-minute panel sync snapshot.
The two-minute TCP probe reads only the xui_inbounds table, writes probe results back to it, and sends no 3x-ui requests.
Read-only inbound consumers (inbound management page, account node status, provisioning inbound lookup, custom-inbound view, group resync) read the table and never probe.
Write paths that validate inbound existence refresh the table from 3x-ui without probing; toggling an inbound's enable state updates the table immediately.
The /api/xui-inbounds and /api/account/node-status response shapes are unchanged and both pages render without console or page errors.
